notes.title: Update Notes for August 9th
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Endless mode would unlock after beating the main game (more specifically, it would unlock after the credits completed). Now it unlocks right before the credits play -- this means players don't have to watch the entire credits in order to have the mode unlocked.
[*] Players now have the ability to unlock endless mode through the main menu settings.
[/list]
